description: Set the organization's default_timezone (an IANA zone such as Europe/Paris), or null to clear it. Only works when the person behind the credential is an Owner or Admin; otherwise it returns 403.

default_timezone.description: IANA time zone such as Europe/Paris, or null to clear it so Etc/UTC applies.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

name: shipmail_update_organization

default_timezone.description: Zone used when a request and the calendar of the person behind the credential name none. Null means Etc/UTC.
